caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a jockey standing atop a rectangular, light gray pedestal. The jockey is dressed in a red cap, a red long-sleeved jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, and white pants tucked into tall black boots with brown cuffs. The jockey's right arm is bent at the elbow, crossing the body with the hand angled palm up as if holding something, while the left arm is raised and extended forward, also bent at the elbow, with the palm facing outward and fingers curled slightly. The figure has a dark complexion, and the background of the drawing is plain, with a light tan or beige color. There is a small inscription at the bottom right, reading "PAUL PFEIFENBARGER."
title: Cast Iron Dobbie: Jockey
